name: Backstep makes target unit distant, then draws a card
notes: Backstep's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid; after paying, control passes straight to the opponent's EffectStackOpponentResponse window (no separate active-player window this time), so a single P2 PASS resolves the stack before the ability's own MZCHOOSE target decision appears. Choosing the seeded Dungeon Guide makes it distant and draws a card.
